subject: Pilot onboarding confirmation & access roadmap — Silverpine Systems
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Maya Ortiz <maya.ortiz@silverpine.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding confirmation & access roadmap — Silverpine Systems

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. This note summarizes what we discussed and the proposed next steps to get the 6-week pilot kicked off. Please skim and tell me if anything needs to change.

Key pain points you shared
- Latency spikes on peak workload (affects multi-user search experience)
- Token costs creeping up when model decisioning is applied to every query
- Limited observability into per-route costs and token-level tracing
- Compliance requirement for audit logs and documented retention policy

Pilot goals (success criteria)
- Functional: 95th percentile latency <= 300ms for our routed generation endpoint under target load
- Throughput: sustain 200 requests/sec steady-state with graceful degradation at spikes
- Cost: demonstrate a ~30% reduction in per-utterance inference cost vs your current baseline through batching/caching and a quantized model variant
- Quality: pass a 500-sample prompt set with >=90% parity on key intents (we'll co-author prompt set)

Scope and timeline
- Duration: 6 weeks (kickoff week + 4 weeks evaluation + final readout)
- Key deliverables: sandbox environment, prompt evaluation suite, telemetry dashboard, final readout with recommendations and SOW for production rollout

Owners (proposed)
- Silverpine: Maya Ortiz (Product, pilot owner), Evan Liu (Platform/Infra)
- Redwood: Lauren Bishop (engagement lead), Ben Carter (integration/serving runtime), Soojin Lee (solutions / prompt evals)

Immediate access/setup asks (what we need from Silverpine)
1) Cloud account/contact for provisioning (IAM role or site admin)
2) Network notes: will you allow VPC peering or do you prefer our private deployment? (We discussed both options.)
3) Test dataset pointer (S3/GCS) for prompt set and a short sample of sanitized logs
4) List of IP ranges if you prefer IP allowlist

Attachments: I've attached a draft SOW and an access checklist (see attachments).

Proposed kickoff: Thu 3/25 or Mon 3/29 — we can lock in 60-90 minutes for the orientation and environment walk-through.

Next action: Please reply with confirmation on the proposed owners, your preferred kickoff date, and the point-of-contact for infra (Evan ok?). If SOC2 or other compliance artifacts are required up front, call that out and we'll expedite.

Thanks — excited to get this running.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: silverpine_sow_draft.pdf (13KB)
             network_access_checklist.xlsx (8KB)

Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding confirmation & access roadmap — Silverpine Systems

Thanks Lauren — really helpful summary. Confirming a few items from our side:

- Timeline: 6 weeks sounds right. We prefer a Thu 3/25 kickoff if your team can do an afternoon window (PST).
- Owners: Evan will be the infra lead and I will own product acceptance.
- Compliance: We will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a data handling description before production, but for the pilot a SOC 2 summary and the attestation is sufficient. Can you share your SOC2 report and a short compliance packet?
- Network: We prefer to try VPC peering first; if we hit constraints we'll discuss private deployment. Evan will follow up with our cloud account details.

I am copying Evan on the reply — Evan, can you share the contact and whether we can open a peering request this week?

Quick note on the prompt set: product wants to prioritize three core intents (search, summarization, rerank). We'll send a starter list of ~150 prompts and then expand to 500 together.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Maya Ortiz
Senior Product Manager, Silverpine Systems
maya.ortiz@silverpine.com

Subject: Pilot kickoff — network/access checklist & quick infra notes

Lauren / Soojin — looping in a few infra specifics ahead of the 2pm kickoff:

What we need from Silverpine (technical)
1) IAM: either an IAM role (preferred) or a service account with minimal privileges to write to the sandbox bucket and read object metadata.
2) Peering: If you can initiate a VPC peering request, we'll accept and configure routing. If not, share a list of allowed IP ranges and we can use allowlisting for the pilot.
3) Test bucket: short-lived test bucket (S3/GCS) with a sample data file (~10MB) and manifest.
4) Egress: We need confirmation on whether outbound connections are allowed to our telemetry endpoint (telemetry.redwood.com) — HTTPS egress on 443.

Network checklist attached: network_access_checklist.xlsx (small checklist + step-by-step peering flow).

Notes on telemetry & evals
- We'll provision a dedicated sandbox project and a model variant tuned for batching to help hit the cost target.
- Sooj, I'll hand off an initial prompt set (150 samples) by EOD so Maya's team can start reviewing.

If Evan can DM me the peering contact or the cloud account ID, I can open the request from our side within 30 minutes.

Ben Carter
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
